tourPackages.title: Odisha Golden Triangle Tour
tourPackages.description: Explore the religious, archaeological, and cultural heart of Odisha. From ancient temples of Bhubaneswar to the golden sands of Puri and the architectural wonder of Konark.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bhubaneswar
itinerary.description: Pickup from Airport/Station, check-in, visit Lingaraj & Mukteshwar temples, Khandagiri & Udayagiri Caves. Stay in Bhubaneswar.

itinerary.title: Bhubaneswar to Puri via Dhauli
itinerary.description: Drive to Puri. En-route visit Dhauli Peace Pagoda and Pipili Applique Village. Check-in at Puri hotel. Visit Jagannath Temple in the evening and relax at Golden Beach.

itinerary.title: Konark Sun Temple & Marine Drive
itinerary.description: Drive along the beautiful Marine Drive. Visit Chandrabhaga Beach and the magnificent Konark Sun Temple. Return to Puri for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Chilika Lake Sanctuary & Departure
itinerary.description: Excursion to Satapada (Chilika Lake), spot Irrawaddy Dolphins and visit Sea Mouth. Return to Bhubaneswar for departure transfer.

tourPackages.title: Chilika & Gopalpur Beach Escape
tourPackages.description: A serene getaway to Indiaâ€™s largest coastal lagoon, Chilika Lake, paired with the colonial beach town of Gopalpur-on-Sea.

itinerary.title: Bhubaneswar to Gopalpur
itinerary.description: Drive from Bhubaneswar to Gopalpur. Check-in at luxury beach resort. Relax on the pristine beach and watch the vintage lighthouse.

itinerary.title: Chilika Lake Barkul Exploration
itinerary.description: Excursion to Barkul side of Chilika Lake. Take a speedboat cruise to Kalijai Temple island and Nalabana Bird Sanctuary.

itinerary.title: Tara Tarini Temple & Departure
itinerary.description: Visit the sacred Tara Tarini Hill Shrine, enjoy panoramic river views. Drive back to Bhubaneswar for departure.

tourPackages.title: Bhitarkanika Wildlife Odyssey
tourPackages.description: Immerse yourself in Indiaâ€™s second largest mangrove ecosystem, home to giant saltwater crocodiles, monitor lizards, and exotic migratory birds.

itinerary.title: Bhubaneswar to Bhitarkanika
itinerary.description: Drive to Khola entry gate of Bhitarkanika. Check-in at eco-luxury tents. Evening forest walk and cultural performance.

itinerary.title: Full Day Creek Safari
itinerary.description: Enjoy a thrilling boat safari through dense mangrove creeks. Spot crocodiles, deer, and kingfishers. Visit the ancient hunting tower of kings.

itinerary.title: Pentha Beach & Departure
itinerary.description: Visit the beautiful pine-fringed Pentha Beach. Drive back to Bhubaneswar for airport/railway transfer.

blogs.title: The Ultimate Guide to Exploring Bhubaneswar: Temple City of India
blogs.summary: Discover the rich architectural heritage, history, and food culture of Odishaâ€™s capital city, from ancient Lingaraj Temple to modern cafes.
blogs.content:
Bhubaneswar, the capital of Odisha, is famously known as the Temple City of India. With a history spanning over 3,000 years, the city once boasted more than 7,000 temples. Today, several hundred beautiful stone temples still stand as a testament to the Kalinga style of architecture.

### Top Temples to Visit:
1. **Lingaraj Temple:** Built in the 11th century, this majestic temple is dedicated to Lord Shiva and stands at a soaring height of 180 feet.
2. **Mukteshwar Temple:** Widely recognized as the "Gem of Odisha Architecture" due to its famous arched gateway (Torana) and detailed carvings.
3. **Rajarani Temple:** Beautifully carved with female figures and standing in manicured gardens, famous for its unique sandstone colors.

### Best Way to Get Around:
To tour Bhubaneswar comfortably in the hot and humid climate of Odisha, hiring a reliable luxury car or a spacious Tempo Traveller for group excursions is highly recommended. Shibani Tour & Travels provides custom local sightseeing packages with expert native drivers.
